title: Snowsports School Tariff Schedule: Session Price, Block Price and Session Structure
content:
Rates and session structure in force for the products of the Snowsports School, as carried on the collective's tariff schedule.

## 1. What this schedule fixes

For each Snowsports School product the schedule fixes five figures: the price in USD of one session for one participant at the standard rate; the price in USD of the whole block of sessions the product is sold as; the number of instruction sessions one booking of the product holds; the length of one session in hours on the mountain's clock; and the number of consecutive weeks a multi-week product runs over.

## 2. Schedule

| Product | Session price (USD) | Block price (USD) | Sessions per booking | Session length (hours) | Programme weeks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 179.00 | 179.00 | 1 | 3.00 | 1 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 259.00 | 259.00 | 1 | 5.00 | 1 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 309.00 | 309.00 | 1 | 5.00 | 1 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 129.00 | 749.00 | 6 | 2.00 | 6 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 549.00 | 549.00 | 1 | 3.00 | 1 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 949.00 | 949.00 | 1 | 6.00 | 1 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 459.00 | 2295.00 | 5 | 6.00 | 1 |

## 3. Reading of the schedule

Five of the seven products hold a single session per booking, and for those five the session price and the block price stand at the same figure. Two products hold a block of several sessions: the Six-Week Development Programme, whose block holds six sessions, and the Elite Performance Camp, whose block holds five.

## 4. Worked readings of the figures above

These readings are drawn from the schedule alone and introduce no further rate.

- A booking of the Six-Week Development Programme holds six sessions of two hours each, which is twelve hours of instruction spread over six consecutive weeks, and its block is sold at 749.00 USD.
- A booking of the Elite Performance Camp holds five sessions of six hours each, which is thirty hours of instruction run inside a single week, and its block is sold at 2295.00 USD.
- The five single-session products between them run from three hours at the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson and the Semi-Private Coaching Session, through five hours at the Mountain Explorers Group Lesson and the Mountain Cubs Group Lesson, to six hours at the Private Instruction Full Day.
